primary_estimand: Deterministic full-policy certification and complete work for every registered case. The real-arithmetic theorem gives an explicit update bound for all target matrices satisfying the declared coercivity conditions and every isotropic orientation. No population confidence interval is estimated from these runs.
information: Both methods receive the same declared exact-population LQ model. Neural targets evaluate already finalized own-policy futures; no Riccati optimum is provided to the learner or verifier. The structural baseline is allowed to exploit the model fully.
allocation: Half tolerance divided by a certified zero-action reference value; allocate each Gram tolerance with an additional factor-two margin; check every eight hidden updates and at the ideal half-target iteration cap.
failure_policy: No unregistered rescue or relaxation. All construction failures terminate with their traceback retained; all final failed certificates remain in the primary record. No result-conditioned budget change.
scope: Same 24-date multisector quadratic tracking economy and all-adapted-policy target as R23. This is a constructive NBO learning experiment, not empirical calibration, simulation superiority, or an independent population replication.
chronology: Source and this protocol must be committed remotely before primary execution. Development tests may use only dimensions 1,2,3,4 and horizons 2,3,4. No primary run prior to freeze.
